enroll.description: You will finally receive an email <0>around 8 PM</0> inviting you to join the association, with a link to create your account and order the membership on the shop.
enroll.title: The Membership

tour.description: Your experience begins with a guided tour of <0>approximately 30 minutes</0> of our premises, where a volunteer will show you the different work areas and the <1>rules to follow</1>.
tour.title: The Tour

trial.description:
You will then be invited to take a seat at a workstation for a trial day <0>until 7 PM</0>, to experience the atmosphere and determine if the place suits you.

The <1>Wi-Fi credentials</1> are accessible at any time within the app.
trial.title: The Trial Day
